# Phrasebank {#sec-phrasebank}

Useful expressions for each part of a research article. Adapt them; do not paste them mechanically.

## Introduction

- *X is a central issue in…* / *There is growing interest in…*
- *Previous studies have shown that… (Smith, 2020; Lee, 2022).*
- *However, little is known about… / Few studies have examined… / It remains unclear whether…*
- *This study aims to… / Here, we examine… / In this paper, we report…*

## Methods

- *Data were obtained from… / We collected data from… between… and…*
- *Participants were recruited through… / The sample consisted of…*
- *We used X to estimate… / Analyses were conducted in R (version…).*
- *The study was preregistered at… / Data and code are available at…*

## Results

- *Table 2 shows… / As shown in Figure 3,…*
- *X was associated with Y (β = 0.32, 95% CI [0.18, 0.46]).*
- *We found no evidence that… / The difference was small and imprecise.*

## Discussion

- *These findings suggest that… / This is consistent with… / In contrast to…*
- *One possible explanation is that…*
- *Our design does not allow us to conclude that…*
- *Future research could…*

## Conclusion

- *In summary, … / Taken together, these results indicate…*

## Correspondence

- *I am writing to… / I would be grateful if you could… / Please find attached…*
- *I look forward to hearing from you. / Kind regards,*

## Peer review

- *The manuscript addresses an important question… / My main concern is…*
- *I would encourage the authors to… / It is unclear from the text whether…*

## Responses to reviewers

- *We thank the reviewer for this helpful comment.*
- *We have revised the text accordingly (p. 7, lines 140-152).*
- *We respectfully disagree, because…*
